verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and HR SaaS platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only UI help-center articles on payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration, none of which mention a public API or spec. The probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate. The help-center search URLs are Zendesk host-platform endpoints and earn no credit.
